svg.title: Buyout Multiples of Annual Rent by Source and Tenant
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-cell-lease-buyout-multiples; chapter number: 2; title: Buyout Multiples of Annual Rent by Source and Tenant; subtitle: Fine print and carrier identity move the multiple from 5x to 25x; caption: Easement buyers paid 24-25x for AT&T rent and about 5x for US Cellular on the same rooftop, while aggregator offers cluster at 8 to 15 times.; assumptions note: Ranges are as quoted by each practitioner. Typical values are the speaker's stated point where one exists (17.5x Tower Genius worked example, 14x Acquisition Insider discount example); otherwise the midpoint of the quoted range.; note: Sources: Tower Genius (pSGbaA0AbTo @ 00:00:32); Acquisition Insider (MtWLazzJb9Y @ 00:02:09, 00:02:26); Selina Gonzales (x2ZfqDSKoOI @ 00:07:17); James Furlo, Furlo Capital (bk4EnTlbPdA @ 00:11:22).; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: x annual rent; bars: label: Aggregator Offer to Shopped Lease; min: 8; max: 18; typical: 14; display: 8-15x offers; ~18x shopped multi-carrier; label: Tower Genius Average to Clean Lease; min: 16; max: 19; typical: 17.5; display: 16-17.5x average; 19x with 3% escalator, no ROFR; label: Ground Lease Buyout Band; min: 15; max: 21; typical: 17.5; display: 15-20x typical; peak near 21x in 2024; label: AT&T Tenant on a Rooftop; min: 24; max: 25; typical: 24.5; display: 24-25x; label: US Cellular Tenant on a Rooftop; min: 5; max: 5; typical: 5; display: About 5x
